## Improvements

- Restore proportional compact catalogue cards.
- Share details-style actions across inline previews, fullscreen trailers and quick actions.
- Always open manual trailers and idle details-page trailers fullscreen, with black letterboxing.
- Disable hover trailers on Search and Continue Watching; keep inline controls visible.
- Group playback and sorting/filtering settings into smaller expandable sections, with wrapping and padding.
- Use one three-language priority for stream ranking and playback audio selection.
- Improve native trailer resolution, fallback and inline/fullscreen transitions.
- Retain thumbnail timing/cache safeguards while allowing fast alternate thumbnail sources.
- Restrict automatic episode advancement to valid IntroDB outro markers.

Local validation: signed 32-bit release build and 236 passing unit tests (one skipped).
Physical-TV focus, animation and decoder validation remains necessary.
